items.title: Optimizing Apache HBase availability on Amazon EMR, Part 2: Diagnose and tune compaction
items.summary: Compaction keeps HBase read performance healthy, but when it runs during peak hours it drives latency spikes, write stalls, and RegionTooBusyException errors. In Part 2 of this series, you learn how to confirm compaction is the cause on Amazon EMR, tune the right parameters in the least-invasive order, and know when to stop and contact AWS Support.
items.creator: Reekunj Parmar
